run_pose_inference: run topdown pose estimation on an image using a config and checkpoint file
run_heatmap_visualization: run pose inference with heatmap visualization enabled for predicted keypoints
run_skeleton_visualization: run pose inference and visualize skeleton in mmpose or openpose style
run_keypoint_threshold: run pose inference with a custom keypoint confidence threshold for visualization
run_save_result: run pose inference on an image and save the annotated result to an output file
